settings.html: Know the signs

settings.title: Signs It’s Time to Replace Your Water Heater

settings.editor: Most tank water heaters last 8 to 12 years. Central Iowa’s hard water speeds up sediment buildup inside the tank, which makes the heater work harder and can shorten its life. If yours is in that age range and starting to show these signs, replacing it before it fails is usually cheaper than cleaning up after a leak.

settings.html:
• Your hot water runs out faster than it used to
  • Water looks rusty or discolored
  • Rumbling or popping sounds come from the tank
  • There’s water pooling around the base
  • The unit is more than 10 years old
Tank or tankless

settings.title: Water Heater Options for Your Home

settings.editor: A traditional tank water heater stores and heats 40 to 80 gallons at a time, so hot water is ready when you need it. It’s the most common choice and the lowest cost to install. We install gas and electric models.

A tankless water heater heats water only when you turn on the tap, so you never run out in the middle of a shower. It takes up less space, uses less energy because it doesn’t keep a tank hot all day, and often lasts up to 20 years. It costs more upfront and sometimes needs gas line or venting upgrades.

It depends on your household’s hot water use, your fuel type, the space you have, and your budget. We’ll walk you through the options during a free in-home estimate and recommend the right size for your family. A unit that’s too small runs out of hot water, and one that’s too big wastes energy.
